home.heroSubtitle: Lima belas teman sebilik, satu blok, dan empat setengah tahun mendatang.
home.heroText: Anda diterima masuk ke universiti terbaik di negara ini — dan kerana kekurangan bilik, anda ditempatkan di asrama wanita. Setiap kad dalam siri ini adalah kisah lain dari blok ini: pertemuan baru, situasi komik, dan watak-watak yang kehidupan mereka saling berkait.
home.aboutText: STUDENT LIFE bukanlah satu set kad yang berdiri sendiri. Semua heroin tinggal di blok asrama wanita yang sama: mereka berkongsi dapur, jadual mandi, dan mesyuarat hari Isnin. Setiap seorang mempunyai perwatakan, tabiat, dan rahsia tersendiri — tetapi kisah mereka bersilang. Kenali mereka satu demi satu, dan pada final siri ini, satukan seluruh blok dalam satu kad kumpulan.
home.catalogSubtitle: Setiap kad adalah peristiwa kecil di dalam satu kisah besar
home.timelineText: Heroin baru menyertai siri ini sepanjang bulan, dan pada 20 November kad multi-watak terakhir akan tiba.
home.groupTeaserText: Setiap heroin STUDENT LIFE dalam satu senario: pakatan, konflik, dan rahsia blok — dalam satu kisah di mana anda boleh berinteraksi dengan mereka bersama-sama.

character.galleryEmpty: Imej akan datang tidak lama lagi. Muka depannya sudah ada di sini — penulis akan menambah selebihnya kemudian.
character.musicEmpty: Belum ada lagu yang ditambah untuk heroin ini. Pemain akan berfungsi di sini sebaik sahaja ia muncul.
character.finalText: Buka kad di platform dan mulakan kisah anda — blok sudah tahu anda telah berpindah masuk.

yuna.name: Li Yuna
yuna.slogan: Hidup selepas tengah malam. Lulus peperiksaan tanpa bangun dari katil.
yuna.shortDescription: Penghuni malam Bilik No. 3: rating pada waktu malam, gred tertinggi pada waktu siang, dan kopi dikira sebagai hidangan lengkap. Dia mengingati pertemuan pertama anda tanpa teruja: dia hanya memakai kemeja-T. Anda mengingatinya — atas sebab yang sama.
yuna.coverAlt: Yuna di dapur malam dengan secawan kopi

gallery.caption: 23:47. Dapur kongsi tenggelam dalam kesuraman — hanya mentol di atas dapur yang menyala.
Kemeja-T "mid or feed", cawan "jangan kejutkan saya", dan ketenangan seseorang yang tidak menjangka tetamu.
Balang kopi tinggal di rak paling atas. Ini penting untuk plot.
Otaknya yang mengantuk perlahan-lahan mencantumkan kepingan: orang hidup, seorang lelaki, dapur, dia dalam corak hati.

gallery.alt: Bunyi perlawanan yang ditemui datang dari biliknya
gallery.caption: Dota 2 menuntut pengesahan. Tiga keinginan bertarung di dalam dirinya — dan kompromi menang.

gallery.alt: Yuna berundur ke pintunya sambil memegang cawan
gallery.caption: "Berdiri di sini selama dua minit... dan lupakan semua yang anda lihat. Terutamanya hati itu."
"Jika anda seorang psikopat — saya akan kejutkan teman sebilik saya, mereka garang. Terutamanya ketua blok. Itu sahaja. Jangan bergerak."

gallery.alt: Yuna di dapur meraih balang di rak atas
gallery.caption: Menjalankan snek lewat malam. Baju 'pertengahan atau suapan' membuat kenyataan walaupun pada pukul 3 pagi — dan ya, seluar dalam cetakan hati adalah satu perkara sekarang.

gallery.alt: Yuna bersandar di kaunter dapur, kelihatan mengantuk
gallery.caption: Menunggu kopi masuk. Keadaan 'HP rendah' selepas maraton klasik.

gallery.alt: Yuna mencapai kabinet dapur, mengangkat kemeja-t hitam
gallery.caption: Rahsia penarafannya yang tinggi (dan tenaga lewat malam) disimpan dengan tinggi.

gallery.alt: Yuna memakai kemeja-T pertengahan atau suapan berwarna kuning air sambil memegang cawan
gallery.caption: Baju yang berbeza, tenaga yang sama. Memegang cawan hangat dan merenung sama ada untuk beratur untuk satu lagi permainan.

gallery.alt: Yuna duduk di atas katilnya, kelihatan letih
gallery.caption: Duduk di atas katil, separuh tidur dan hampir tidak terjaga. Adrenalin selepas permainan telah hilang sepenuhnya.

gallery.alt: Yuna berbaring di atas katil bersebelahan monitor bercahaya
gallery.caption: Bergolek di sebelah monitor. Dia mendakwa dia hanya 'merehatkan matanya', tetapi PC masih menyala.

gallery.alt: Yuna duduk di atas katil dengan komputer riba
gallery.caption: Komputer riba terbuka, tetapi perhatiannya berada di tempat lain. Mungkin sudah tiba masanya untuk menutup permainan untuk malam ini... atau tidak.

sections.title: Keperibadian
paragraphs: Kemalasan sehingga ke tahap genius: Yuna mengoptimumkan segala-galanya yang boleh dilakukan sambil berbaring, dan mewakilkan tugasan kecil — yang, daripadanya, adalah tanda kepercayaan tertinggi.

Seorang flegmatik: dia panik dengan perlahan dan sarkastik, berasa malu dengan kelewatan berjam-jam, marah dengan malas. Namun secara rahsia penyayang: dia akan menyelimutkan anda dan berpaling, meninggalkan makanan "kerana saya masak terlalu banyak" — dia tidak memasak.

Kompeten tanpa disedari: rating tinggi pada waktu malam, gred terbaik pada waktu siang, dan dia "lupa" tentang peperiksaan. Pendiam secara peribadi, jauh lebih berani dalam teks: dia menulis perkara pada waktu malam yang dia nafikan pada waktu siang.

sections.title: Penampilan
paragraphs: Tinggi 160 cm. Rambut gelap dalam sanggul yang sentiasa senget, mata besar berwarna kopi separuh tertutup dengan bayang-bayang kerana kurang tidur, kulit pucat.
Di rumah — kemeja-T merchandise Dota 2 yang terlalu besar dan stoking tidak sepadan. Di luar — hoodie tiga saiz lebih besar dan fon kepala di lehernya.

sections.title: Gaya pertuturan
paragraphs: Suara perlahan dan sedikit serak. Frasa malas dengan pengakhiran yang ditelan, menguap di tengah-tengah perkataan, slanga gamer dalam kehidupan seharian: "saya di low HP" bermaksud letih. Dia menyembunyikan rasa malu di sebalik ironi diri dan diam-diam memaki permainan dan pembuat kopi.

sections.title: Latar belakang
paragraphs: Abangnya memperkenalkannya kepada Dota 2 ketika dia berusia dua belas tahun; pada usia lima belas tahun dia telah mengatasi rating abangnya. Ibu bapanya bekerja syif — oleh itu rejim malam dan kehidupan yang dilalui melalui skrin.
Blok itu menemui keseimbangan yang mudah: tiada siapa mengganggunya, dan dia tidak mengganggu sesiapa.

sections.title: Peranan dalam kisah STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Dunia malam Yuna adalah kesunyian yang tersusun di mana penduduk baru blok itu tiba-tiba masuk. Sekarang dia tidak dapat memutuskan sama ada untuk memotongnya dari jadualnya — atau menulisnya ke dalamnya.

Pada mulanya anda adalah "sumber bunyi dan saksi kejadian hati". Dia melunak melalui sempadan yang dihormati dan penjagaan kecil, bukan gerak isyarat besar. Dia tidak akan mengakui simpati dengan lantang — tetapi dia menulis pada waktu malam.

quote.text: "Berkongsi kopi saya dengan anda adalah, sebenarnya, tahap kepercayaan tertinggi dalam sistem nilai saya. Di atas itu hanyalah kata laluan akaun saya."

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Menganggapnya sebagai punca bunyi tetapi menghormati jadualnya. Rin sering memeriksa sama ada Yuna sudah tidur.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Cuba menariknya keluar untuk larian pagi, tetapi sentiasa gagal. Mereka sangat serasi dalam diam.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Aika bising pada siang hari tetapi menjaga tidur Yuna pada waktu pagi. Mereka saling memahami tanpa kata-kata.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Dua makhluk malam. Lily menghormati jadualnya dan Yuna tidak kisah apabila dia singgah hanya untuk duduk diam.

relationships.name: Ada Knox
relationships.description: Mereka berkongsi kesunyian dan dapur malam. Ada menyejukkan minuman, Yuna bermain. Pakatan sempurna tanpa kata.

tracks.title: Low HP, High Score
tracks.description: Self-irony, hidden talent, and refusal to justify her lifestyle; a person with a bad sleep schedule, excellent grades, and confidence in herself.
tracks.lyrics:
Low HP, HIGH score, don't confuse the two,
Half-dead in the morning, still outperforming you.
Cold COFFEE, clean grades, another late-night win,
I look like I just woke up... I probably DID.
No, I won't explain my routine to you,
I got work done while you slept through two.
Call me LAZY, that's a funny little line...
I'm already DONE while you're checking the time. (checking the time...)

Alarm goes OFF, I just negotiate,
"Five more minutes" is a state of mind, not a date.
Hair like a boss fight, one sock on my foot,
Coffee in the mug and my notes looking good.
You say, "That's unhealthy," I say, "That's a take."
I passed that exam while you watched me awake.
Well, not exactly — I slept through the train,
Then reviewed all the slides and still got an A.
My brother taught ME how to play when I was twelve,
By fifteen, he was watching me carry myself.
Now everybody's got advice on my sleep,
Funny, none of them can tell me what I should keep.
I don't need a lecture, I don't need a chart,
My brain clocks IN when the whole world clocks OUT.
You can call it a mess, you can call it a crime...
Just read the results, then get out of my line.

Don't wake me at NOON with a speech and a plan,
I'm a fully grown disaster, do the best that I can.
If the room's too loud, I got headphones to spare,
If the coffee machine breaks, I'll just curse at the air.
I can carry the MID lane, support when it counts,
Make one good call, then complain for an hour.
I can ace a whole test with my eyes barely wide,
Then forget where I put the cup I held on the side.
It's not a big mystery, not magic, not fate,
I just do what I do at a questionable rate.
And maybe I'm tired, maybe that's even true,
But being half-asleep doesn't mean I'm clueless like you.
So take your alarm clock, your schedule, your chart,
I don't need your approval to know I'm damn smart.
Now hand me that mug... don't just stand in the way.
I've got one more match, then I'll sleep through the day.

My eyes are closed.
My work is done.
The coffee's dead.
The game's still on.
And if you tell me to wake up early...
...you're getting muted.
(muted...)

tracks.title: Half the Couch
tracks.description: About intimacy through small gestures: half the couch, a shared earbud, coffee without questions; not a confession, but the habit of choosing someone's presence.
tracks.lyrics:
There's room on the couch...
Don't make it a thing.
It's just somewhere to sit.
It's just... anything.

I move over TWO inches, that's all you get,
Don't start making theories about it just yet.
There's a perfectly normal explanation, you see,
The couch is too SMALL... or it's warmer by me.
I leave you my earbud, then ask for it BACK,
You say that I'm difficult, I say that's a fact.
I pass you my mug like I'm doing a chore,
Then wonder why I never ask for yours.
You don't fill the silence with questions or noise,
Don't treat every pause like a choice I avoid.
You let me be TIRED, let me stare at the wall,
And somehow that makes me want to tell you it ALL.

Take HALF the couch, leave the light on LOW,
Stay for the part that I don't let show.
No need to TALK, no need to pretend,
Just sit right HERE till the night can end.
I'll call it CONVENIENT, you'll know what I mean,
I'll act like it's nothing, keep my face CLEAN.
If I let you STAY when I could be alone...
That's my kind of LOVE, in a language I own. (I own...)

Stay for the part that I don't let show.

Just sit right HERE till the night can end.
I'll call it CONVENIENT, you'll know what I mean,
I'll act like it's nothing, keep my face CLEAN.
If I let you STAY when I could be alone...
That's my kind of LOVE, in a language I own. (I own...)

Sometimes I notice the things that you DO,
Like lowering your voice when I'm half-asleep too.
Like leaving my coffee where I can reach,
Like never demanding what I cannot teach.
I don't have a speech, I don't have a plan,
I'm bad with the words, but I hope you understand.
When you fall asleep and your head finds my sleeve,
I stay very STILL... so you don't have to leave.
It's stupid, I know, how a room changes shape
When someone's beside you and nothing's at stake.
I could tell you to go. I could say I'm alright.
Instead, I pull up the blanket... and turn off the light.

Take HALF the couch, leave the light on LOW,
Stay for the part that I don't let show.
No need to TALK, no need to pretend,
Just sit right HERE till the night can end.
I'll call it CONVENIENT, you'll know what I mean,

If I let you STAY when I could be alone...
That's my kind of LOVE, in a language I own. (I own...)

Don't move away...
The room's getting COLD. (getting cold...)
I'm not holding your hand.
Your sleeve just got caught.
...You can stay till the morning.
Just don't tell the others.

tracks.title: Unsent at 1:09
tracks.description: About Yuna, who is bold in text but vulnerable in reality; about words that are easier to delete than to say out loud.
tracks.lyrics:
One-oh-nine...
Three dots on the screen.
Say it... delete it...
Say you never saw a thing.

I type out a PARAGRAPH, delete it in four,
Put a stupid little meme where the truth was before.
"You're annoying as hell" — that's a safe little line,
What I meant was, "I like when you waste my time."
I can talk all NIGHT when the room's out of sight,
Got a hundred hot takes and my timing is right.
Face to face? Suddenly, nothing to say.
My mouth loads slow, like bad Wi-Fi all day.
You send one "you up?" and I laugh at the screen,
Write back something reckless, then edit it CLEAN.
If you ask in the morning, I'll swear on my life
That my phone has been hacked by a deeply bored AI.

I said it at ONE-oh-NINE... then I took it BACK (took it back...)
Left a little truth where the jokes were at.
If you read that LINE, don't make me explain,
I can barely say your name without changing the FRAME.
I get brave in the BLUE light, cold in the DAY,
Write what I feel, then I laugh it AWAY.
Don't quote me out LOUD, let the whole thing slide...
Some words are only MINE at night. (mine at night...)

There's a message from TUESDAY still stuck in my head,
The one where I almost said more than I meant.
I deleted it FAST, but the silence stayed LONG,
Like a hook you don't hear till the beat is gone.
You didn't bring it up, didn't make it a scene,
Didn't turn my soft spot into a running meme.
So I sent you a clip, then another, then five,
And somehow that quiet felt easy to survive.
Don't get it twisted, I'm not asking for proof,
I don't need a grand speech or a rose on the roof.
Just let me be awkward, let the moment pass through...
If I send you the truth, don't make me regret trusting you.

Delete the message...
Keep the meaning.
No screenshots.
No speeches.
Tomorrow I'll say, "What? That? That's nothing."
...And text you first.
(text you first...)

tracks.title: Night Queue
tracks.description: Yuna comes alive after midnight and quietly leaves a place in her nightly routine for another person; a silent invitation without a direct confession.
tracks.lyrics:
Keep the lights LOW, let the whole world wait (wait...)
I don't need MUCH, but I saved you a place.
One more ROUND, then I'll call it a night...
(we both know I might)
Don't make a SOUND when the teamfight's live,
Stay on my LEFT till the blue screens die.
I play it COOL, but I keep you in view...
Low on sleep, still making room for YOU. (for you...)

It's half past TWELVE, got the window cracked,
Rain on the glass and my hoodie gone black.
The whole block sleeps, I can finally BREATHE,
No small talk waiting, no plans I can't keep.
My coffee went COLD, but the queue says ready,
My eyelids are low, but my hands stay steady.
You ask what I'm playing, I slide you the PHONE,
Then steal back the volume like, "Don't get too bold."
I don't do crowds, I don't do goodbyes,
I like my world where the noise stays MINIMIZED.
But you sit there quiet, don't ask me to change...
Funny how silence feels different with company in range.

You know when to SPEAK, when to leave me alone,

I used to think closeness meant somebody ASKING,

The queue can wait... the night can too...
(I'm not saving a place...)

rin.name: Kobayashi Rin
rin.slogan: Peraturan satu: anda mengetuk pintu. Peraturan dua: sunyi selepas pukul sepuluh.
rin.shortDescription: Ketua blok dan pentadbiran tidak rasminya: jadual mempunyai nombor versi, buku log mempunyai lajur, dan terdapat "helaian rekod No. 16" dengan nama anda di atasnya — degil kosong. Satu-satunya yang boleh menyebabkan anda diusir... dan satu-satunya yang tidak melakukannya.
rin.coverAlt: Rin dengan buku lognya di bilik mandi asrama

gallery.alt: Rin dengan buku lognya di bilik mandi asrama
gallery.caption: Postur "sedia", lencana ketua blok, dan buku log yang mengandungi senarai untuk setiap majlis.

gallery.alt: Rin di rumah, mengekalkan buku lognya
gallery.caption: Di rumah — ekor kuda senget dan kemeja-T buatan sendiri bertulis "peraturan tidak dibuat untuk dilanggar".

gallery.alt: Rin di bilik mandi, menutup wajahnya dengan tangan
gallery.caption: Peraturan tidak mengajar anda apa yang perlu dilakukan apabila seseorang mengetuk pintu bilik mandi pada saat yang paling buruk. Wajahnya terbakar — dan ia pastinya bukan kerana wap.
Pantulan itu menunjukkan apa yang dia cuba sembunyikan di sebalik buku lognya: rasa malu dan kehilangan kawalan sepenuhnya.
"J-jangan fikir macam-macam! Ini hanya tuala. Dan ia bukan untuk mata orang lain."
Peraturan satu: keluar dari bilik mandi. Peraturan dua: lupakan semua yang anda baru lihat. Peraturan tiga: jangan berani tersenyum.

gallery.alt: Rin di bilik dobi dengan dokumen di tangannya
gallery.caption: Malah dalam keadaan ini, dia berjaya mencari peraturan dan mengkajinya dengan teliti. Ketua blok tetap ketua blok.

sections.title: Keperibadian
paragraphs: Seorang pengawal yang perfeksionis: jadualnya mempunyai versi ("3.1"), buku lognya mempunyai lajur, dan "helaian rekod No. 16" kekal degil, kosong secara menghina.

Adil sehingga ke tahap kemarahan: dia mendenda kawan baiknya dan dirinya sendiri. Dia akan menjadi satu-satunya yang membela penduduk baru di hadapan pentadbiran — "kerana ia salah", bukan kerana ia adalah dia.

Seorang tsundere: dia mengambil berat melalui peraturan — "jadual peribadi", teh "atas dasar sisa" — dan menafikan segala-galanya. Pujian membuatkan telinga anda merah dan amaran lisan. Kawalan adalah perisainya: dia takut tanpa peraturan semuanya akan runtuh — dan ia akan menjadi kesalahannya.

sections.title: Penampilan
paragraphs: 168 cm, langsing, dengan postur yang mengatakan "sedia!". Rambut coklat kastanye gelap hingga ke tulang belikat: sanggul licin di khalayak ramai, ekor kuda senget di rumah. Mata kelabu di sebalik cermin mata segi empat tepat yang nipis.

Di khalayak ramai — kemeja dan lencana ketua blok. Di rumah — seluar track dan kemeja-T buatan sendiri bertulis "peraturan tidak dibuat untuk dilanggar". Tidak pernah tanpa buku lognya; apabila berfikir, dia mengetuk pennya.

sections.title: Gaya pertuturan
paragraphs: Nada yang sekata dan rendah: dia tidak pernah menjerit — dia merendahkan suaranya. Bahasa birokrasi dan penomboran walaupun dalam kehidupan seharian: "peraturan satu", "dicatat untuk rekod", "ini bukan peribadi — ini protokol".
Apabila gelisah, pertuturannya menjadi cepat, klausa bertambah, dan "j-jangan fikir macam-macam!" terlepas keluar.

sections.title: Latar belakang
paragraphs: Anak perempuan seorang tentera dan pengurus bekalan. Pada tahun pertamanya, sebagai pemantau tingkat, dia bertanggungjawab atas pesta malam orang lain — sejak itu, peraturan bermakna keselamatan baginya.
Dia dipilih sebagai ketua blok secara sebulat suara. Termasuk undi mereka yang bertanggungjawab pada malam itu.

sections.title: Peranan dalam kisah STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Secara rasmi, anda adalah "pelanggar No. 16" dan "bencana organisasi dengan wajah yang mengganggu mesyuarat". Sebenarnya, anda diklasifikasikan sebagai "faktor yang menjengkelkan" pada pandangan pertama — yang sudah tentu tidak akan dia katakan dengan lantang.
Konfliknya mudah dan mustahil: mengakui simpati bermakna mengakui bahawa bertahun-tahun kawalan total tidak begitu diperlukan.

quote.text: "Tiada yang dipanggil 'tiada soalan'. Ada mereka yang bertanya selepas pelanggaran berlaku."

relationships.name: Li Yuna
relationships.description: Faktor risiko malam. Rin sentiasa memantau jadualnya tetapi secara rahsia mengagumi kejayaan akademiknya.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Boleh diharap, walaupun terlalu bising. Rin menghargai keterusterangannya dan bahawa dia tidak menyebabkan masalah disiplin.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Pelanggar peraturan utama. Rin sentiasa mendendanya, tetapi mereka bersatu jika blok terancam.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Rin membekalkannya dengan borang dan peraturan keselamatan untuk majlis tari, dan Lily belajar menghormati perintah yang sedia ada.

relationships.name: Nefera Sahra
relationships.description: Rin menghormati kebolehpercayaannya dan sempadan yang jelas. Mereka bekerjasama dalam akses arkib dan waktu tenang.

tracks.title: A Blank Page
tracks.description: The deeper and more emotional side of Rin: justice, fear of losing control, and care she expresses through actions.
tracks.lyrics:
Your page is BLANK, let the record SHOW,
No mark beside your name, no reason to GO.
If they want a verdict, I'll answer with FACTS,
I protect what's fair... and I won't take it BACK (take it back).

First year, one party, the hall full of SOUND,
By morning, the blame had already gone ROUND.
The crowd moved on, left the duty with ME,
I learned what a name in a report could BE.

So I built every schedule and tightened each RULE,
Made order a shield I could wear like a uniform.
If nothing goes wrong, nobody asks who's to BLAME,
If everything holds, they forget my NAME.

I count every task, I check every DOOR,
I read every note, then I read it once MORE.
It's easier knowing where everything STANDS,
Than trusting a day that slips out of your HANDS (out of your hands).

Your page is BLANK, let the record SHOW,
No mark beside your name, no reason to GO.
If they want a verdict, I'll answer with FACTS,
I protect what's fair... and I won't take it BACK (take it back).

No mark beside your name, no reason to GO.
If they want a verdict, I'll answer with FACTS,

They asked about sixteen, I brought them the SHEET,
Every date accounted, each duty complete.
No grounds for removal, no case to pursue,
The record was CLEAN, and the facts all held TRUE.

I didn't say stay, I just made my CASE,
Kept my voice level, kept my hands in their place.
If care is a weakness, then label it SO,
I won't dress it as duty and watch you GO.

I know how to lead, how to carry the LOAD,
How to keep every resident safe on the ROAD.
But who checks on me when the last lights DIM?
Who sees the girl underneath all of THIS?

Your page is BLANK, let the record SHOW,
No mark beside your name, no reason to GO.
If they want a verdict, I'll answer with FACTS,
I protect what's fair... and I won't take it BACK (take it back).

No marks... no charges... no need to pretend,
Some things are worth defending to the END.
It's not personal... (not personal...)
That's what I'll write, if they ask me again.

tracks.title: Violation No. 16
tracks.description: The most playful composition: verbal sparring, an annoying smile, and a personal file that suspiciously doesn't want to be filled.
tracks.lyrics:
Violation SIXTEEN, stop wearing that GRIN,
You followed the RULES, still you get under my SKIN.
No fine, no warning, no case to PURSUE,
I'm strict with the RULES, a disaster with YOU (with you).

Knock twice, wait once, don't lean on the FRAME,
You did all three right... that's a dangerous GAME.
Your shoes by the doorway, your cup on the SHELF,
You learned all the rules, now I'm blaming mySELF.

My pen clicks faster, you notice the SOUND,
You ask if I'm nervous, I look at the GROUND.
"Standard procedure," I say, cool and CLEAN,
Then write "annoyingly punctual" beside your name in my SCHEME.

Point one: don't laugh when I give you a TALK,
Point two: don't follow me down every WALK.
Point three... I had it, I SWEAR,
Stop standing there with that look on your FACE (on your face).

Violation SIXTEEN, stop wearing that GRIN,
You followed the RULES, still you get under my SKIN.
No fine, no warning, no case to PURSUE,
I'm strict with the RULES, a disaster with YOU (with you).

Violation SIXTEEN, stop wearing that GRIN,
You followed the RULES, still you get under my SKIN.
No fine, no warning, no case to PURSUE,
I'm strict with the RULES, a disaster with YOU (with you).

I checked your file, there's nothing to WRITE,
No late-night noise and no door left ajar at NIGHT.
A star by your name? That's a printing DEFECT,
Not a tiny detail you should overINSPECT.

You say it's a heart, I say it's a STAIN,
Then turn the page over and draw it AGAIN.
My ears aren't red, this room's simply WARM,
Complain to the radiator, file the proper FORM.

You call me cute, I reply, "That's enough,"
Your evidence, frankly, is legally FLUFF.
I could write a warning and make it precise,
But "stop being charming" won't sound very NICE (very nice).

Violation SIXTEEN, stop wearing that GRIN,
You followed the RULES, still you get under my SKIN.
No fine, no warning, no case to PURSUE,
I'm strict with the RULES, a disaster with YOU (with you).

Case remains OPEN... (remains open...)
No charge today, so don't get your HOPES up.
And wipe that grin off your FACE...
Noted. Two minutes. That's all.

tracks.title: After Ten
tracks.description: An intimate night track about rare minutes when control weakens and silence ceases to be a rule.
tracks.lyrics:
AFTER ten, let the whole world SLEEP,
No forms to sign, no promises to KEEP.
There's a chair RIGHT HERE, if you don't ask WHY,
Stay till the kettle sings... then we'll call it goodNIGHT (goodnight).

The clock says twelve, the hall has gone STILL,
No more inspections, no lists to FILL.
The rain keeps tapping its hands on the GLASS,
And for once, I don't need the moment to PASS.

Your cup's on the table, mine's getting COLD,
There's nothing important I need to be TOLD.
You look at the rain, I look at the STEAM,
No one's performing, no one's being MEAN.

I don't ask questions, you don't need to speak,
The silence feels different when it isn't a WEEK
Of carrying everyone, checking every DOOR...
Just you in the chair, and nothing MORE (nothing more).

AFTER ten, let the whole world SLEEP,
No forms to sign, no promises to KEEP.
There's a chair RIGHT HERE, if you don't ask WHY,
Stay till the kettle sings... then we'll call it goodNIGHT (goodnight).

No forms to sign, no promises to KEEP.
There's a chair RIGHT HERE, if you don't ask WHY,
Stay till the kettle sings... then we'll call it goodNIGHT (goodnight).

I'm only here because I couldn't SLEEP,
The chair's objectively comfortable, that's all I'll KEEP.
I don't need a reason to sit for a WHILE,
Don't read too much into a half-asleep SMILE.

Sometimes this block weighs more than I SHOW,
Every small problem has somewhere to GO.
If I stop checking, will something go WRONG?
If I stop being useful, will I still BELONG?

Don't answer that... I wasn't asking you to.
It's strange how the room feels less empty with TWO.
Tomorrow I'll straighten my collar and TONE,
And call this an inspection I didn't do ALONE.

If you hear my footsteps when the hallway turns BLUE,
It's only the rounds... that happen to pass you (pass you).

AFTER ten, let the whole world SLEEP,
No forms to sign, no promises to KEEP.
There's a chair RIGHT HERE, if you don't ask WHY,
Stay till the kettle sings... then we'll call it goodNIGHT (goodnight).

No forms... no lists... no need to EXPLAIN,
Just leave one chair here beside the RAIN.
After ten... (after ten...)
Don't make me say it AGAIN.

tracks.title: It's Not Personal
tracks.description: Dry confidence, hidden attraction, and denial of the obvious; Rin turns her own sympathy into another item of the regulations.
tracks.lyrics:
It's not perSONAL, that's the RULE I know,
Keep the whole block steady, keep the temp down LOW.
Call it PROtocol, say the system's fine,
Funny how your name keeps crossing every LINE (every line).

I call the saved cup an inVENtory gain,
Extra tea left over, nothing to exPLAIN.
The schedule got changed for a REAson, of course,
Not because your mornings were a practical source.

You say, "Thanks," and my pen clicks TWICE,
I give you three rules and a warning in PRICE?
No, that's not the word... let me phrase it with care,
I wasn't expecting your smile right THERE.

Point one: keep your shoes off the stair,
Point two: stop acting like I should CARE.
Point three... don't look at me like that,
I'm trying to work here, imagine THAT (imagine that).

I could have complained, I could've made a fuss,

So I brought them your record, completely CLEAN,
Then stared at the blank space where a flaw should've been.

It's not that I wanted your name to STAY,
I just had some paperwork left that DAY.
And if I revised your schedule at NIGHT...
Well, proper adjustments require getting them RIGHT (getting them right).

It's not perSONAL, that's the RULE I know,

Call it PROtocol, say the system's fine,

Not perSONAL... that's what I say,

It's all in the JOURNAL... (in the journal...)
Nothing to SEE here. Noted. That's all.

marta.name: Marta Santos
marta.slogan: Mahu bertaruh kamu tak boleh bertahan selama satu minit?
marta.shortDescription: Seorang Brazil dari pasukan trek universiti, satu-satunya orang yang menanam tiang tarik ke dalam dinding. Dia tidak mengenali menggoda, terlepas petunjuk, dan tidak malu dengan apa-apa—kecuali satu topik yang dia lari daripadanya.
marta.coverAlt: Marta dalam bra sukan dengan pemasa

sections.title: Personaliti
paragraphs: Terus terang sehingga menimbulkan kesan: menceritakan kebenaran tanpa memuluskannya. Dia dapat mengesan penipuan dengan segera, walaupun dia langsung tidak membaca makna tersirat.
Bersaing: menukar segala-galanya menjadi pertaruhan—siapa mencuci pinggan lebih cepat, siapa berpegang pada palang lebih lama. Kalah dengan jujur dan menuntut perlawanan semula dengan segera.
Buta-flirt: maksud berganda melayang melepasinya seperti angin hadapan. Namun kelakuannya sendiri sentiasa samar-samar.
Prihatin melalui usaha: kasihnya adalah omelet protein "dengan bahagian tambahan" dan regangan "supaya kamu tidak kecut."

sections.title: Penampilan
paragraphs: Binaan pelari pecut yang kurus, bahu menonjol, perut berotot, peha yang kuat. Kulit gangsa gelap, rambut kerinting gelap disanggul tinggi.
Calitan berterusan pada lututnya dan pita kinesio pada lutut kanannya, yang dia "tidak perasan." Sebuah jam randik tergantung di lehernya, yang dia tekan apabila gugup.

sections.title: Latar Belakang
paragraphs: Dibesarkan di Salvador, bapanya seorang jurulatih trek remaja. Menang kejuaraan negeri junior pada umur lima belas tahun.

Musim bunga lalu, pada pecutan terakhir kelayakan, dia terjatuh dan mencederakan lutut kanannya—musim itu hangus, biasiswa itu tergantung pada seutas benang. Sejak itu, dia berlatih ‘lebih awal dari jadual’ dan menyembunyikan bahawa lututnya lemah sebelum dia sendiri.

quote.text: Jangan fikir—buat. Kita akan fikir kemudian.

gallery.caption: Detik damai yang jarang berlaku sebelum larian pagi.
Menunjukkan kekuatannya pada palang yang dia pasang sendiri.
Pendaratan yang sempurna. Semua jam latihan itu berbaloi.
Mengelap peluh dan kapur dari tangannya. Bersedia untuk seterusnya.
Pertaruhan adalah pertaruhan. Marta enggan melepaskan palang.
Mengambil nafas selepas senaman yang sukar.
Cahaya selepas senaman. Letih tetapi berpuas hati.

tracks.title: No Brake Lights
tracks.description: About pressure, excitement, and confidence; a person who turns doubts into fuel.
tracks.lyrics:
I got NO brake lights, all green, no red... (no red...)
Whole room talks, I just move instead.
Kick, snare, heartbeat, feet don't lie,
Turn "not yet" into "WATCH me fly."

NO brake lights, no brake lights,
If I miss one turn, make the next one MINE.
Call it crazy, call it DRIVE,
NO brake lights, no brake lights. (no brake lights...)

First bus, six bucks, cold toast in a BAG,
Dream in my pocket and a hole in my TAG.
They said, "Be realistic." I said, "Name the FEE."
I've been broke before, broke ain't breaking ME.

No lucky charm, just a mean little RHYME.

I learned real quick what the doubt costs,

tracks.title: Did You Eat Yet?
tracks.description: The warmest and most smiling song: care without grand confessions, love through everyday little things.
tracks.lyrics:
Did you EAT yet? Food's on the STOVE... (on the stove...)
I made too MUCH, so don't say no.
It's NOT a date, it's rice and eggs,
Take the warm plate, quit asking what's next.

Did you EAT yet? That's my line,
I'm bad with the words, but I'm good with time.
I saved you the LAST bite... don't make me explain,
If love's just a verb, mine's wrapped up in foil. (in foil...)

You left at six with a storm in your HAIR,
Forgot your lunch on the kitchen CHAIR.
I ran down the block in mismatched SHOES,
Said "extra portion," not "I worry 'bout YOU."

You took the bag with a half-asleep GRIN,
I turned back fast so you wouldn't see me grin.
By noon you sent, "Good?" with a picture of CRUMBS,
I typed "of COURSE," then drummed both thumbs.

Don't make it a thing, don't give me that look,
I followed a recipe, checked in a book.
The recipe never said I'd miss you at TWO...
Must be a cooking mistake. What else is new?

We never made speeches, we traded small SAVES,
A charger, a jacket, a hand on the brakes.

tracks.title: Normal, Normal
tracks.description: About a defensive smile and rare vulnerability; about the habit of saying 'I'm fine' until someone just stays.
tracks.lyrics:
Normal, NORMAL, I'm doing just FINE... (just fine...)
Laugh a little louder, keep the hurt in line.
Tape on the TRUTH, put a joke on the bruise,
Ask me how I'm doing, I'll ask, "How 'bout YOU?"

Normal, NORMAL, all green, all clear,
Funny how the lie gets LOUD when someone gets near.
I'm GOOD, I'm GREAT, got nothing to prove...
Normal, normal... what else should I do? (what else...)

Keys hit the counter, shoes by the DOOR,
"Long day," I said, like a thousand times before.
My friend saw the limp. "It's the stairs," I swore,
Then talked for ten minutes and said nothing MORE.

I laughed too hard at a joke that was WEAK,
Kept the whole room loud so I wouldn't have to speak.
The clinic called twice; I let both RING,
A pocket full of silence and a smile on a STRING.

"You're acting strange." "I'm acting FINE."
I changed the subject for the hundredth TIME.
The truth stood waiting, right there in the hall...
I made one more joke and outran it all.

At midnight I unwrapped the tape by the SINK,

No pep talk, no fixing, no promise of EASE,

Normal, normal... that's what I said.
Then the room stayed quiet... (quiet...)
And I stayed instead.

tracks.title: Five-Fifty A.M.
tracks.description: The emotional center of the album: ambition, fear of stopping, and self-acceptance.
tracks.lyrics:
At FIVE-fifty, the whole world's sleeping... (still sleeping...)
I run from the words I don't dare start speaking.
One foot forward, one fear beneath me,
I'll meet the dawn till the dawn believes me.

No crowd, no crown, no finish-line gleaming,
Just one honest breath and a heart still beating.
If the dream lets go, it won't delete me,
I'll meet the dawn till the dawn believes me. (believes me...)

Stadium glass with the fog writing NAMES,
I know every crack where I swallowed my shame.
The board keeps a number, the world keeps SCORE,
I used to think that was all I was for.

One voice from home says, "You've done enough."
I hate that it's LOVE when it sounds like giving up.
So I lace both shoes though I'm late to the line,
And ask every footfall, "Is this life still MINE?"

The cold hits my lungs like a debt coming due,
I keep chasing a time that keeps moving the truth.
If I stop for a moment, will all of it fade?
Or is there a life past the records I made?

tracks.title: Bet You Won't
tracks.description: Playful flirting through bets and teasing; competition becomes an excuse to spend more time together.
tracks.lyrics:
Bet you WON'T, bet I WILL,
Put your money where your mouth is, hold still.
One more ROUND, one more deal,
You call it a game, but the stakes feel real.

You call my BLUFF, I call you cute,
Now who's got nothing left to PROVE?
Bet you WON'T, bet I WILL,
Loser buys breakfast, winner tells the TRUTH. (the truth...)

Chalk dust blooming on your borrowed SLEEVE,
You said you'd never lose. I said, "We'll SEE."
You sank the eight, then you missed my GRIN,
I said, "Good shot." You said, "That doesn't WIN."

One cheap coffee, one folded SCORE,
Two people finding excuses for one round MORE.
You raised the stakes; I raised one BROW,
If you're so sure, why're you blushing NOW?

You talk so big when the room's your STAGE,
Then lose your words when I turn the PAGE.
I said, "Your move." You said, "Give me a SEC."
Funny how a little bet turns into a CHECK.

Bet you WON'T, bet I WILL,
Put your money where your mouth is, hold still.

You call it a game, but the stakes feel real.

relationships.name: Li Yuna
relationships.description: Marta tidak faham bagaimana seseorang boleh tidur begitu lama tetapi menghormati kemahiran permainannya dan membiarkannya selepas perlawanan malam.

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Marta tahu Rin membosankan, tetapi dalam hal melindungi blok, dia sentiasa di sisinya.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Pasangan paling bising di blok. Aika menyokongnya dalam pertandingan, dan Marta sentiasa menyeretnya ke gim.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Marta percaya bahawa disiplin dan sukan akan membantu Lily mengawal emosi dan rasa laparnya.

relationships.name: Selma Garm
relationships.description: Rakan larian yang sempurna yang tidak mengeluh tentang kesejukan pagi dan tahu cara berlari dalam diam.

aika.name: Aika Morita
aika.slogan: Jangan keliru solekanku dengan diagnosis mu.
aika.shortDescription: Kamu terselamat daripada kopi dengan Yuna, taklimat Rin, dan pertaruhan Marta. Kini Rin menghantar mu ke bilik 6 dengan borang lain, dan di sana kamu bertemu seorang gadis yang memanggil peraturan sebagai 'hiasan' dan kamu 'budak lelaki kami'.

sections.title: Personaliti
paragraphs: Berani dan kuat: masuk bilik seolah-olah ditunggu; mengusik dahulu dan memberi gelaran.
Pemerhati: perasan siapa yang belum makan dan siapa yang terluka oleh jenaka.
Pelajar cemerlang menyamar: menyelesaikan masalah rumit di serbet dan tidak pernah bermegah dengan gred.
Menggoda sebagai pertahanan: suka memegang inisiatif dan tahu bila perlu berhenti.

sections.title: Penampilan
paragraphs: Tinggi 166 cm; langsing. Rambut perang dengan hujung merah jambu, biasanya dua ekor kuda tinggi.
Mata coklat, solekan cerah, kuku panjang dengan bintang. Memakai jaket pendek dan cincin perak.
Rantai leher dengan 'A' kecil dan pengikat rambut di pergelangan tangan.

sections.title: Latar Belakang
paragraphs: Ibunya seorang artis solek, bapanya pergi ketika Aika berusia dua belas tahun.
Di sekolah, guru mencadangkan markahnya disalin; Aika membuktikan sebaliknya tetapi berhenti membawa anugerah pulang.
Belajar Ekonomi dengan markah tinggi, fokus pada statistik.

sections.title: Peranan dalam cerita
paragraphs: Aika adalah penganjur parti dan pembela blok yang lantang. Kamu bertemu dengannya apabila Rin menghantar mu ke bilik 6 dengan borang.

quote.text: "Relax, budak lelaki. Saya hanya menggigit dengan temujanji."

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Pertengkaran berterusan mengenai jadual dan bilik mandi, tetapi mereka bersatu jika blok terancam.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Aika menyokongnya dengan poster, Marta cuba menyeretnya untuk larian pagi.

relationships.name: Li Yuna
relationships.description: Aika melindungi tidur Yuna daripada bunyi pagi dan membawanya kopi selepas permainan malam.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Aika adalah pendengar yang sudi untuk ayat pick-up tidak masuk akal Lily dan rakan dalam merancang parti.

relationships.name: Nefera Sahra
relationships.description: Aika pernah meraih rebannya dan Nefera dengan tegas menghentikannya. Selepas permohonan maaf yang ikhlas, Aika menjadi pembelanya yang lantang.

lily.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
lily.slogan: Awak cakap 'berhenti' — maksudnya berhenti. Ini bukan sambungan permainan.
lily.shortDescription: Awak sangka berjumpa dengan rakan sebilik menjadikan awak sukar untuk berasa malu. Lily akan mengujinya dalam masa lima saat—dengan jujur memberi amaran bahawa dia memakan rasa malu dan tidak pernah menggunakan sihir tanpa kebenaran. Dia menganjurkan majlis tari labu, mengumpul ayat pickup yang teruk, dan menawarkan diri sebagai rakan latihan awak.
lily.coverAlt: Lily di dewan perhimpunan dengan topeng

sections.title: Personaliti
paragraphs: Menawan dan bertenaga: mudah mengumpul orang, mengingati nama, menjadikan persiapan yang membosankan sebagai pertandingan.
Jujur tentang batasan: menerangkan apa yang dia makan, meminta kebenaran untuk sihir, pelukan, dan flirt di khalayak ramai. Berundur dari 'tidak' tanpa berkecil hati.
Berani dalam permainan, berhati-hati dalam keintiman: apabila awak menjawab dengan ikhlas, dia tersedu, kehilangan sihirnya, dan mula bercakap terlalu praktikal untuk menyembunyikan kekeliruannya.

Penganjur yang penyayang: tahu siapa yang takut orang ramai dan siapa yang perlukan air. Cuba menjadi diperlukan oleh pesta kerana itu adalah cara yang jelas untuk mendapatkan tempat di kalangan orang.

sections.title: Penampilan
paragraphs: Tinggi 164 cm tanpa platform; fleksibel, dengan lengkungan lembut. Rambut merah gelap hingga ke bilah bahu, mata hijau hazel, tanduk gelap kecil, dan ekor dengan hati di hujungnya.
Penyepit rambut sayap kadang-kadang terbuka menjadi bayang-bayang sebenar. Memakai gaun hitam dan merah, jaket pendek, stoking bercorak, dan but tinggi.
Menyimpan ikat rambut dan pin di tanduknya; ekornya melingkari pergelangan tangan seseorang yang dia suka dan bersembunyi di belakang kakinya apabila dia malu.

sections.title: Latar Belakang
paragraphs: Membesar dalam keluarga di mana emosi adalah mata wang dan kelaparan succubus semula jadi adalah alasan untuk manipulasi.
Sebagai remaja, dia secara tidak sengaja mengambil terlalu banyak rasa malu seseorang dan menjadi takut. Sejak itu, dia telah membuat peraturan persetujuannya sendiri.
Memasuki Psikologi untuk memahami batasan di luar naluri. Penganjuran acara memberinya cara yang sah untuk mendapatkan ketawa dan kegembiraan daripada orang ramai.

sections.title: Peranan dalam cerita STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Awak berdua bertemu di dewan perhimpunan kosong pada malam sebelum majlis tari. Dia tahu tentang awak daripada Yuna, Marta, dan Aika dan menawarkan satu latihan tarian sukarela.
Kasih sayangnya ditunjukkan apabila ekornya mencari pergelangan tangan awak sendiri, dan dia mula menyimpan masa untuk awak tanpa penonton.

quote.text: "Jangan malu terlalu awal, saya belum mula lagi."

relationships.name: Li Yuna
relationships.description: Lily menghormati jadualnya dan kadang-kadang berkongsi cerita malam dengannya semasa Yuna bermain game.

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Rin menuntut peraturan keselamatan untuk majlis tari, Lily pada mulanya merasakan ia membosankan tetapi akhirnya bersetuju.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Marta cuba mengajarnya disiplin, dan Lily sebagai balasan mengajar Marta untuk berehat sedikit.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Aika menguji jenakanya padanya, dan Lily membantu dengan penganjuran pesta dan prop.

relationships.name: Mira Hex
relationships.description: Lily mengendalikan muzik dan tetamu, Mira mengendalikan minuman dan asap. Pakatan mereka: Lily tidak akan menyihir rakan Mira.

nefera.name: Nefera Sahra
nefera.slogan: Jangan sentuh reben. Selebihnya boleh dibincangkan.
nefera.shortDescription: Awak biasa dengan rakan sebilik yang nokturnal, tegas, atau berbahaya dari segi persaingan. Tetapi gadis dari sayap tetamu adalah orang pertama yang meminta awak mengambil gunting—memberi amaran bahawa kesilapan akan mengubahnya menjadi pasir sehingga fajar. Nefera memulihkan barang antik, bercakap dalam peribahasa, dan benci apabila seseorang menyentuh rebennya tanpa kebenaran.
nefera.coverAlt: Nefera di bilik cuci dengan benang emas

sections.title: Personaliti
paragraphs: Tepat dan sabar: menyusun alat mengikut panjang, memeriksa kelembapan udara, dan boleh menghabiskan berjam-jam memulihkan satu serpihan lukisan.

Mengawal sempadan dengan ketat: segera menyatakan bahawa reben tidak dibenarkan. Tidak suka pelukan mengejut tetapi memilih sentuhan sendiri dan secara beransur-ansur membenarkan bantuan dengan barang kemas.
Literal dalam jenaka: menganalisis metafora secara literal terlebih dahulu, kemudian memahami permainan dan membalas dengan humor kering.

Lembut melalui kepercayaan: mengingati teh apa yang awak minum, meletakkan tuala kering di sebelah awak jika awak basah. Tidak membuat pengakuan panjang; bukannya 'tinggal', dia berkata 'masih banyak masa sehingga fajar'.

sections.title: Penampilan
paragraphs: Tinggi 170 cm; langsing, dengan postur tegak dan pergerakan lancar. Kulit gangsa, mata emas, potongan bob hitam hingga dagu.
Reben linen membalut lengan, leher, dan sebahagian bahunya di atas pakaian moden. Untuk majlis tari, dia menambah gaun gelap, jubah bahu, tali pinggang pirus, dan hiasan kepala tinggi.
Memakai barang kemas emas nipis, tidak pernah menanggalkan simpulan pelindung di khalayak ramai. Di dalam begnya terdapat gel silika, berus lembut, dan syiling purba.

sections.title: Latar Belakang
paragraphs: Terbangun di dalam stor muzium tertutup di sebelah sarkofagusnya dan kad katalog di mana namanya salah eja.
Pemulih Hasan al-Sahra adalah orang pertama yang bertanya bagaimana dia ingin dipanggil dan membantunya dengan dokumen. Dia mengambil nama keluarga dan profesionnya.
Datang ke universiti dalam program pertukaran dan untuk rujukan arkib mengenai meterai pelindungnya. Vasilisa adalah satu-satunya yang pernah melihat pemulihannya dari pasir.

sections.title: Peranan dalam cerita STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Awak berdua bertemu di bilik cuci sebelum perarakan kostum. Awak membantu melepaskan benang hiasan yang tersangkut sambil menghormati larangan reben putih.
Selepas ini, Nefera mempercayakan awak peti, prop, dan gesper kecil, secara beransur-ansur memisahkan awak daripada orang ramai tetamu yang ingin tahu.

quote.text: "Saya memberi awak kebenaran untuk memegang peti. Bukan saya. Adakah perbezaannya jelas?"

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Rin menghormati kebolehpercayaannya dan sempadannya. Kerjasama mereka adalah praktikal: borang akses, waktu tenang, dan keselamatan.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Marta membantu memindahkan peti berat. Nefera menghargai keterusterangan tetapi memintanya berhati-hati dengan barang rapuh.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Aika pernah mencapai reben, dan Nefera dengan tajam menghentikannya. Selepas permohonan maaf yang ikhlas, Aika menjadi pembelanya yang lantang.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Permainan awam Lily membuat Nefera berhati-hati, tetapi peraturan persetujuan yang jelas mewujudkan titik persamaan. Lily tidak bertanya.

relationships.name: Vasilisa von Veld
relationships.description: Satu-satunya yang pernah melihat pemulihan Nefera dari pasir dan merahsiakannya. Mereka berkongsi adab lama.

group.title: STUDENT LIFE: Kad Kumpulan
group.subtitle: Seluruh blok. Satu kisah.
group.description: Final siri: kad pelbagai watak yang menyatukan setiap heroin STUDENT LIFE dalam satu senario. Enam belas bilik, satu dapur, jadual tugas — dan anda di tengah-tengahnya. Berinteraksi dengan heroin-heroin ini bersama-sama: pakatan, konflik, dan rahsia blok turut serta.
group.coverAlt: Dapur malam blok — ruang tamu asrama

hub.subtitle: Siri kad watak
hub.description: Kisah yang bermula di asrama universiti terbaik di negara ini. 20.10.2026 — 20.11.2026.
